intro: The Encrypted Sigil is an introductory summons directed to nascent night elf rogues arriving in Shadowglen. Carried by Conservator Ilthalaine on behalf of Frahun Shadewhisper, it directs covert operatives to initiate their training and heed the fragile peace threatening Kalimdor.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: This sigil was given to me by a messenger from our rogue trainer, Frahun. It seems Frahun would have words with you when you have a moment. Read it and bring it to him afterwards.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Hello, friend. I'm glad you found me. I was thinking that perhaps you got lost on the way here.
Nothing really new has happened in Shadowglen since I sent you my sigil, but I'll leave all the information gathering to you. Speak to the rest of the people around Aldrassil if you'd like.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Until then, know that our kind are needed more than ever in this tenuous time. Peace with the other races can fail at any moment, and there is much talk about members of the Horde looking to sow even greater seeds of distrust. Remember that.
As you gain in power and feel more prepared, come back to me here and I will see about getting you some training. It's important that you know how to handle your weapon of choice, among other things.

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
